steps.title: Prepare Sterilized Instruments
steps.instruction: Sterilize instruments via autoclave or by washing with 70% (vol/vol) ethanol. If ethanol is used, dry thoroughly. Soak dissection tools in 70% ethanol between embryos to prevent contamination.

steps.title: Isolate Embryos and Tissue
steps.instruction: Prepare 10 cm dishes with cold PBS in a hood. Separate embryos from uterus and placenta, placing each embryo into a single dish with cold PBS. Number dishes and Eppendorf tubes for genotyping.

substeps.instruction: Euthanize embryos by decapitation and separate the head from the body.
Wash bodies twice with PBS and collect a small piece of tail for genotyping.
Place the body on a dish with PBS and remove the bowel (red spot) with forceps.
Place the body on a clean dish and mince the tissue using spring scissors or sterile scalpel blades.

steps.title: Dissociate Tissue into Cells
steps.instruction: Prepare digestion medium by adding 125 µL of DNase I (10 mg/mL stock) to 10 mL of 0.025% Trypsin (1:1 Trypsin 0.05%-HBSS).

substeps.instruction: Add 5 mL of digestion medium to the tissue and transfer to a 15 mL falcon tube.
Incubate at 37 °C in a water bath for 15 minutes.
Mechanically dissociate tissue via gentle, sequential pipetting (using 10 mL, 5 mL, and 1 mL pipettes) until cells are completely suspended.
Inactivate trypsin digestion by adding 5 mL of culturing medium.
Centrifuge at 1200 rpm for 5 minutes.
Remove media and resuspend in 5 mL culturing media.
Filter the cells through a 70 μm filter.

steps.title: Plate and Culture MEFs
steps.instruction: Determine cell density and viability by taking a 15 µL aliquot and adding Trypan Blue in a 1:1 ratio for cell counting.

substeps.instruction: Plate 3.0 × 10^6 cells/well in 10 cm dishes containing 10 mL of pre-warmed culturing media.
Change media every 5 days; grow to 90% confluence and split (maintain minimum 25% confluence).
Use primary MEFs between 8-10 passages.

steps.title: Isolate Mitochondria from MEFs
steps.instruction: Treat MEFs (plated in 15 cm dishes, 80-90% confluence) for 4 hours with 10 µM Antimycin A and 1 µM Oligomycin dissolved in DMSO at 37 °C to depolarize mitochondrial membrane potential.

substeps.instruction: Wash twice with 5 mL of warmed DPBS (room temperature) containing protease and phosphatase inhibitors.
Place the 15 cm dish on ice and add 1 mL of Hypotonic Buffer.
Scrape cells, collect in a 15 mL microcentrifuge tube, and add 2 mL of Hypotonic Buffer (total 3 mL).
Incubate on ice for 15 minutes in the cold room.
Homogenize cells using a stainless steel Dounce homogenizer with 45 strokes (verify 80-90% disruption via light microscope).
Add 2.5X MSH buffer to the disrupted cells and mix to achieve 1X MSH.
Centrifuge homogenate at 700 x g for 10 minutes in a refrigerated centrifuge to remove debris and nuclei.
Transfer supernatant to a new 15 mL tube and centrifuge again at 700 x g for 10 minutes at 4 °C.
Centrifuge at 9000 x g for 10 minutes at 4 °C to pellet mitochondria.
Resuspend mitochondria in 1 mL of 1X MSH buffer and centrifuge at 9000 x g for 10 minutes at 4 °C; repeat twice to remove cytosolic proteins.
Centrifuge at 9000 x g for 10 minutes at 4 °C and resuspend pellet in 150 µL of MUB Buffer.

steps.title: Isolate Mitochondria from HeLa Cells
steps.instruction: Treat HeLa cells (plated in 15 cm dishes, 80-90% confluence) for 2 hours with 10 µM Antimycin A and 1 µM Oligomycin dissolved in DMSO at 37 °C to depolarize mitochondrial membrane potential.

substeps.instruction: Wash twice with 5 mL of warmed DPBS (room temperature) containing protease and phosphatase inhibitors.
Place the 15 cm dish on ice and add 1 mL of Hypotonic Buffer.
Scrape cells, collect in a 15 mL microcentrifuge tube, and add 2 mL of Hypotonic Buffer (total 3 mL).
Incubate on ice for 15 minutes in the cold room.
Homogenize cells using a stainless steel Dounce homogenizer with 25 strokes (verify 80-90% disruption via light microscope).
Add 2.5X MSH buffer to the disrupted cells and mix to achieve 1X MSH.
Centrifuge homogenate at 700 x g for 10 minutes in a refrigerated centrifuge.
Transfer supernatant to a new 15 mL tube and centrifuge again at 700 x g for 10 minutes at 4 °C.
Centrifuge at 9000 x g for 10 minutes at 4 °C to pellet mitochondria.
Resuspend mitochondria in 1 mL 1X MSH buffer and centrifuge at 9000 x g for 10 minutes at 4 °C; repeat twice.
Centrifuge at 9000 x g for 10 minutes at 4 °C and resuspend pellet in 150 µL - 250 µL of MUB Buffer.

steps.title: Quantify Mitochondrial Protein
steps.instruction: Take a 10 µL aliquot of isolated mitochondria, add 1% Triton, vortex, and estimate protein concentration using the Coomassie Protein Assay.

steps.title: Prepare Ubiquitylation Reaction
steps.instruction: Resuspend isolated mitochondria in MUB buffer at ~1 mg/mL (ensure mitochondrial volume is < 10% of reaction volume). Prepare reaction buffer containing 50 mM Tris pH 7.5, 5 mM MgCl2, and 0.5 mM TCEP.

substeps.instruction: Defrost proteins and prepare a master mix containing 1 µM Parkin, 0.1 µM His-UbE1, 1 µM UBE2L3, and 30 µM Ubiquitin (omit Parkin for negative control).
Combine reaction buffer, protein master mix, and 5 µg of mitochondria for a total reaction volume of 50 µL.
Aliquot 50 µL into 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes and start the reaction by adding 2 mM ATP.

steps.title: Incubate and Stop Reaction
steps.instruction: Place Eppendorf tubes in a thermomixer and incubate at 30 °C with shaking at 1000 rpm.

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 2 hours for MEFs or 1.5 hours for HeLa.
Stop the reaction by adding 4X LDS loading buffer containing 10% 2-mercaptoethanol.
Boil samples for 3 minutes at 97 °C.

steps.title: Analyze via SDS-PAGE and Blotting
steps.instruction: Run 20 µL of reaction on Nu-page Bis-Tris 4-12% gels at 120 V for ~2 hours using MES or MOPS SDS Running Buffer.

substeps.instruction: For phospho-parkin and Parkin blots, dilute the final reaction 1 in 25 with 1X LDS containing 2.5% 2-mercaptoethanol.

Transfer gel to PVDF membrane (for phospho-ubiquitin and ubiquitin) or nitrocellulose membrane (for phospho-Parkin and Parkin) in Towbin buffer at 80 V for 1.5 hours on ice or in cold room (use 90 V for 1.5h for HK1). Use only one membrane per tank.
Incubate membrane with blocking buffer (5% milk in 0.1% TBS-Tween) for 1 hour at room temperature.
Incubate with primary antibody, then wash 3 times with 0.1% TBS-Tween for 10 minutes each.
Incubate with secondary antibody, then wash 3 times with 0.1% TBS-Tween for 10 minutes each.
